row.name: Import from agents
row.description: Bring every past session Claude Code, Codex and other agents keep on this computer here, all projects at once, with their titles and times. The agents' files are only read.
row.keywords: import agents claude code codex sessions history migrate projects all

dialog.title: Import from agents
dialog.description: Each agent's past sessions on this computer, by the folder each ran in. Imported ones go under that folder's project and pick up where they left off.
dialog.noAgents: No agent here can list its sessions across folders.
dialog.noSessions: {{agent}} keeps no sessions on this computer.
dialog.more_one: {{count}} more; search to narrow them down.
dialog.more_other: {{count}} more; search to narrow them down.
dialog.missingTip: This folder no longer exists, so the session cannot be imported.
dialog.readOnly: The agents' own files are only read. Subagents come back under their session when it is opened here.
dialog.folderNote: The chosen folder is only read. Importing copies each session into {{agent}}'s own folder first, where it can pick up; you see every file before anything is written.
dialog.noFolderSessions: No sessions to import in this folder.
dialog.readOnlyHeld: A Claude Code session a terminal has open is not imported as it is: close it there first, or fork a copy once it fails.
dialog.listSignIn: {{agent}} needs you to sign in before it lists its sessions

desktop.tabTip: The sessions of the Claude desktop app's Code tab, with its own titles and times
desktop.scratchPath: No project · the Claude desktop app's scratch folders
desktop.archivedTip: Archived in the Claude desktop app; it is imported archived too.
desktop.unavailableTip: Claude Code keeps no transcript of this session for the folder it runs in (it may have been deleted, or be under another folder only), so it cannot be imported.
desktop.note: Only the Claude desktop app's and Claude Code's own files are read. Scratch sessions come in under No project and keep running in their scratch folders; archived ones come in archived. Sessions deleted in the app are not listed.

confirm.title: Copy into {{agent}}'s folder
confirm.description: These files are written into {{target}}. Nothing in the chosen folder changes, and nothing is overwritten except an older copy of a session, which is kept beside it as a .kite-bak file first.
confirm.nothing: Nothing to copy; it is imported from {{agent}}'s own copy.
confirm.backup: The older copy is kept as {{file}}

result.memoryHint: Claude Code's and Codex's own memory of the projects now in Kettu can come into Kettu's memory.
result.conflict: {{agent}}'s own folder has another version of it
result.changed: its file in {{agent}}'s folder changed meanwhile
result.missingFolder: the folder it ran in is not on this computer
result.forkTip: A terminal still has it open, so a copy of it comes in; the original is left as it is.
